_meta.note: Character budgets assume 1080x1080 or 1080x1350 canvas. Conservative limits guarantee no overflow.

L02_big_number.notes: The number IS the design. No blocks.

L03_standard_tip.notes: Standard error/tip slide. Most common layout.

L05_pull_quote.notes: One sentence only. No label, no blocks.

L07_cta_card.notes: Different treatment from ALL other slides.

slide-editorial-split.notes: Image + text split. Headline must fit in half width.

slide-giant-lockup.notes: Giant type. Fewer chars than standard lockup.

slide-hero-image-text.notes: Hero with image overlay. Less text space.

slide-big-number-from-to.notes: From X → To Y transformation stat.

slide-stat-cards-3up.notes: Three stat cards. Very tight per-card budget.

slide-stat-cards-4up.notes: Four stat cards. Minimal text per card.
